g.desc: Kelvin trace at FPGA; local GND reference.

g.text: inside the positive-sense loop when J4902.17 is connected.

g.desc: inside the positive-sense loop when J4902.17 is connected.

g.text: Ground-return drop is NOT compensated: target <=3 mOhm.

g.desc: Ground-return drop is NOT compensated: target <=3 mOhm.

g.text: PGR_CORE reports regulation at FB, not remote ground.

g.desc: PGR_CORE reports regulation at FB, not remote ground.

g.text: Verify loop stability, load release and cable faults on prototype.

g.desc: Verify loop stability, load release and cable faults on prototype.

g.text: R1203 (10.2 kOhm) / R1204 (15 kOhm) regulate CORE_SENSE_P:

g.desc: R1203 (10.2 kOhm) / R1204 (15 kOhm) regulate CORE_SENSE_P:

g.text: R1210 (100 Ohm) provides a local path if the sense wire opens:

g.desc: R1210 (100 Ohm) provides a local path if the sense wire opens:

g.text: local no-load nominal becomes 1.012 V. Open sense may cause

g.desc: local no-load nominal becomes 1.012 V. Open sense may cause

g.text: undervoltage under load; this fallback is not fault-tolerant OVP.

g.desc: undervoltage under load; this fallback is not fault-tolerant OVP.

g.text: L1201 (1 uH) and C1207-C1212 (6 x 47 uF) filter CORE_RAW.

g.desc: L1201 (1 uH) and C1207-C1212 (6 x 47 uF) filter CORE_RAW.

g.text: C1205 (100 nF) is the bootstrap capacitor; C1206 (4.7 uF) bypasses VREG5.

g.desc: C1205 (100 nF) is the bootstrap capacitor; C1206 (4.7 uF) bypasses VREG5.

g.text: R1207 (200 kOhm) / R1208 (10 kOhm) select 400 kHz FCCM and ILIM.

g.desc: R1207 (200 kOhm) / R1208 (10 kOhm) select 400 kHz FCCM and ILIM.

g.text: C1203 (22 nF) sets about 2.2 ms soft start. The 8 A IC capability

g.desc: C1203 (22 nF) sets about 2.2 ms soft start. The 8 A IC capability

g.text: requires sufficient input power and verified board thermal performance.

g.desc: requires sufficient input power and verified board thermal performance.

g.text: CORE1V0 supplies the FPGA internal logic used by the MIRA matrix engine,

g.desc: CORE1V0 supplies the FPGA internal logic used by the MIRA matrix engine,

g.text: precise switching and ADC timing, and fast USB/Ethernet data handling.

g.desc: precise switching and ADC timing, and fast USB/Ethernet data handling.

g.text: It is separate from the FPGA auxiliary and I/O supplies. Generating it

g.desc: It is separate from the FPGA auxiliary and I/O supplies. Generating it

g.text: from FPGA5V5 keeps the core in the controlled FPGA power branch.

g.desc: from FPGA5V5 keeps the core in the controlled FPGA power branch.

g.text: U1201 (TPS568215RNNR) converts FPGA5V5 into the core supply.

g.desc: U1201 (TPS568215RNNR) converts FPGA5V5 into the core supply.

g.text: CMD_CORE drives Q1201; R1201 (100 kOhm) pulls EN_CORE low.

g.desc: CMD_CORE drives Q1201; R1201 (100 kOhm) pulls EN_CORE low.

g.text: The source follower allows enable only with the input rail available;

g.desc: The source follower allows enable only with the input rail available;

g.text: the command driver must provide a defined state and enough EN margin.

g.desc: the command driver must provide a defined state and enough EN margin.

g.text: C1201/C1202 (47 uF each) and C1204 (100 nF) bypass the input.

g.desc: C1201/C1202 (47 uF each) and C1204 (100 nF) bypass the input.

g.desc: FPGA core supply, positive remote sense

g.desc: R1210 fallback: sense open -> local nominal 1.012 V. Validate loop response before PCB release.
